title: American Express earnings Q3 2017
主要内容: American Express reported Q3 2017 earnings that exceeded expectations, with EPS of $1.50 versus $1.48 expected and revenue of $8.44 billion versus $8.285 billion expected. The company also raised its full-year earnings per share guidance to between $5.80 and $5.90, up from the previous forecast of $5.74. CEO Kenneth Chenault will be succeeded by Stephen Squeri on February 1, 2018. The stock initially rose 1.5% in after-hours trading but later gave back gains. American Express is also launching a new card, Blue Delta SkyMiles, targeting millennials. The company faces antitrust scrutiny from the U.S. Supreme Court and competition from JPMorgan Chase's Sapphire Reserve card. American Express shares hit a 52-week high of $93.35.
